issues.message: Non-functional requirements (NFRs) are not defined. Missing specifications for performance metrics, security requirements, scalability targets, availability SLAs, data retention policies, and backup/recovery procedures.

Missing unique constraint on ratings table for (note_id, user_id) combination. This allows users to submit multiple ratings for the same note, violating the stated assumption that users can only rate notes once.
The average_rating column in study_notes table is defined as varchar instead of numeric type (decimal or float). This makes mathematical operations and sorting inefficient and error-prone.
Foreign key relationships lack cascade delete rules. Deleting a user, subject, or group could leave orphaned records in related tables (study_notes, ratings, group_members, notifications, etc.).

Admin and Moderator roles are defined in user_roles but no specific features, user stories, or acceptance criteria describe their functionality. The design also lacks admin/moderator-specific screens or capabilities.

Missing audit trail fields (deleted_at, deleted_by) for soft delete functionality on critical tables like study_notes and study_groups. Current design uses hard deletes or is_active flags without tracking who performed the action.
No specification for file upload size limits, allowed file types, or content moderation policies for study notes, which are critical for security and storage management.

required_fixes: Add comprehensive non-functional requirements including: performance targets (response time, concurrent users), security requirements (authentication, authorization, data encryption), scalability metrics, availability SLAs, and data retention policies
Add unique constraint on ratings table: UNIQUE(note_id, user_id) to enforce one rating per user per note
Change average_rating column in study_notes table from varchar to decimal(3,2) or numeric(3,2) to properly store rating values between 0.00 and 5.00

Define cascade delete rules for all foreign key relationships (e.g., ON DELETE CASCADE for group_members when study_groups is deleted, ON DELETE SET NULL or CASCADE for uploaded_by when users is deleted)
Add feature requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for Admin and Moderator roles, or remove these roles if not needed in MVP
recommendations: Consider adding a rating_count column to study_notes table to avoid expensive COUNT queries when displaying rating statistics
Implement soft delete functionality by adding deleted_at and deleted_by columns to critical tables (users, study_notes, study_groups) to maintain data integrity and enable recovery
Add database-level check constraints: rating value between 1-5 in ratings table, role value in allowed set ('Student', 'Admin', 'Moderator') in users table, and notification type in allowed values
Consider adding full-text search indexes on study_notes.title and study_notes.description columns to improve search performance as the platform scales
Add a file_metadata JSONB column to study_notes table to store additional file properties (page count, author, creation date) without schema changes
Implement rate limiting specifications in NFRs for API endpoints, especially file uploads and downloads, to prevent abuse
Add database migration strategy and versioning approach to technical requirements for managing schema changes in production
Consider adding a user_preferences table to store notification settings, theme preferences, and subscribed subjects separately from the users table for better normalization
